title: Unit Event — Same Dreams, Same Colors — Episode1 A Free Singing Voice

meta.Event Outline: Kohane and the rest of VBS continue practicing in pursuit of greater growth. However, Toya finds himself struggling to understand the vision that his teammates have for a song due to his lack of life experience. That's when Luka offers some advice!

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I did it...!
My voice held up all the way through to the end!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that was very good.
Next, we'll have...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, me! I'll go next...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, take it away.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nice. Your voice feels more powerful compared to before.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! That was so cool, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hehe. Right?
Doing all those street practices was totally worth it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Okay, I'll go next.
Get ready!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Shiraishi began acting a little strange after Azusawa started practicing with Taiga...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But she seems to be back to her old self now. As a result, we seem to be working better as a team.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Isn't there anything I can do to help maintain what we have now...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Oh, I can tell them about the book on vocalization that I bought the other day...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'll just have to keep contributing to this team by using whatever knowledge I have.)
bgm_area00003

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That was great! Another day full of singing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I feel all warm and cozy inside after singing so much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Me too.
Also, I'm glad that we have the option of meeting in SEKAI since it was raining in the park today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It wasn't just raining. It was cold too. We would've all gotten sick if we did practice out there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, but Taiga mentioned how he'd practice even if it rained.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? Seriously?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes.
He said, “If you clear your mind of mundane thoughts, even rain will feel warm.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Practicing in the rain like it's nothing is totally something he'd do.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hold on, Kohane. He didn't make you do that, did he?! There's no way that can be good for you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, we didn't do anything like that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: He also mentioned how the rain doesn't bother him because he's never caught a cold before, so it's not something he recommends to others!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: At the same time, the way he practices did seem a little strange...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Strange how?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: For starters, he had me listen to all sorts of different music and asked me what I thought.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What you thought?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. But not my opinion, like if I thought an artist was good or if I liked the chorus for a song...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: He wanted me to compare music to places or scenery, such as being in a field of sunflowers or seeing the sun set over the sea.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Really?
How's that supposed to help...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is it a sensitivity thing? Does he want you to feel more? After all this time, I still can't get a read on him...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Haha...
It definitely wasn't practice in the traditional sense of the word...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I feel like there's a deeper meaning. I'll keep trying my best to relay what I learn to you guys!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool! Thanks, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now, for our next step...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shall we proceed with discussing which songs we should add to our repertoire?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I brought a few candidates, so let's see if we can listen to them at MEIKO's place!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That person... The one that's been following us. Is that...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? Oh...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Luka?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Huh...? Hey, it's you guys!
Long time no see♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's so great to see all of you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Where have you been all this time?
We haven't seen you at the cafe at all...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Haha. I was having so much fun wandering around this SEKAI that I seem to have lost track of time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We may have just missed each other while I was out and about...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! That's Luka for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope we'll be seeing more of each other from now on. It'd be really nice to sing with you again!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds wonderful!
How about right now?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, really! Let's celebrate our reunion! What do you say, Akito, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure. We haven't seen each other in quite some time, so why not?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'll bite.
Greeting each other by singing does have a nice ring to it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Alright, everyone, get ready!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I'll count us in.
One, two, three, four...
song00005_off_s

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The way Luka sings has so much depth to it...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (She sounds so free, while being flexible enough to complement the way someone else sings.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(It's like she's... At ease.
It'd be great to learn to sing like this.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wow, we really cut loose there, didn't we?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that felt great!
Gimme five, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
High five!
Hehe. And you guys were as good as ever.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, I take that back. You've all improved quite a bit, no? It's like you're all singing with much more clarity now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You think so?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If it's that noticeable, then that means all our hard work's actually paying off.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I agree.
Let's keep this pace up moving forward.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Guys, why don't we have Luka join us while we discuss which songs to add to our repertoire?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're adding new songs?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. We want to try something that we've never done before, so we each came up with some candidate songs and want to see which might work best for us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Which is why it'd be great to hear what you have to say, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think so too.
Would you mind, Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of course! I'd be more than happy to help! Now then, shall we?

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!
